Hi Liam —

Thanks, received your packet. Looping in Ben (Sales Ops) and Kimberly (Marketplace Finance) to owner the PO flow and billing setup. Quick checklist to move forward:

1) Redwood vendor form (fillable) — completing will speed finance review. I'll send the link.

Thanks Vanessa.

Liam — overview of the PO route and next steps from Sales Ops:
- PO routing: send completed PO template to po-requests@redwood.com with subject line 'POREQ-6421 - CumulusOps'
- Finance will validate vendor form + EIN and generally turnaround in 3 business days for standard vendors; priority lane reduces that to 24-48 hours if paperwork is complete.
- Required fields on PO: billing address, remit-to name, EIN, billing contact, expected monthly commitment (if any), and marketplace SKU mapping.

I've attached the PO template (attachment: po-template.xlsx). Please populate and return with the vendor form and proof of insurance. Once we receive those we will provision the listing in the staging marketplace and schedule final QA.

Internal note for Kimberly: tag this as priority and expedite finance approval when we have the completed docs. Finance ticket: POREQ-6421.

Ben Carter
